verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Agora offers RESTful APIs and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, markdown pages). Nothing shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. An API reference explorer is a fair axis for a developer platform, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
